original_utf8:
[engine]
shutdown_deadline_secs = 10
[telemetry]
bind = "127.0.0.1:19140"
[readiness]
min_live_sessions = 3
require_recording_healthy = true
[recording]
shared_directory = ".local/evidence/hyperliquid-integration-review/bybit-native-pilot-01-feed"
shared_max_bytes = 67108864
[recording.raw]
enabled = true
directory = ".local/evidence/hyperliquid-integration-review/bybit-native-pilot-01-raw"
segment_size = "16MiB"
segment_duration = "60s"
queue_capacity = 8192
overflow = "fail_engine"
min_free_space = "1GiB"

[[venues]]
id = "bybit-spot"
adapter = "bybit"
segment = "spot"
transport = "live"
symbols = ["BTCUSDT"]
channels = ["trades", "candles", "quote"]

[[venues]]
id = "bybit-linear"
adapter = "bybit"
segment = "linear"
transport = "live"
symbols = ["BTCUSDT"]
channels = ["trades", "candles", "quote"]

[[venues]]
id = "bybit-inverse"
adapter = "bybit"
segment = "inverse"
transport = "live"
symbols = ["BTCUSD"]
channels = ["trades", "candles", "quote"]
note: pilot-config.toml removes only the trailing empty line to satisfy repository whitespace checks; original_utf8 is the exact launched configuration
